questions.question: How many triangles are there in the given figure? दी गई आकृति में कितने त्रिभुज हैं ?
questions.questionHtml:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

दी गई आकृति में कितने त्रिभुज हैं ?
questions.solution:
Triangles = MRV, NRW, NMA, VAZ, OSX, NSW, NOA, XAZ, OTX, OPA, TPU, AXY, PQU, QVM, AVY, APM, RNS, SOT, TPQ, RMQ, VZX, YZX, VYX, YZV, MNO, NOP, OPM and MNP.

Alternatively: -

Figure is symmetrical in 4 quadrants. So, let us count triangles in one of the quadrant and multiply it by 4.

In 1st quadrant: - MRV, NRW, NMA, VAZ there are 4 triangles.

So, in 4 quadrants there are 16 triangles.

Combining 2 quadrants we get 3 triangles viz. RNS, VZX and MNO.

So, total there are 12 triangles.

Total number of triangles = 16 + 12 = 28

Consider one square

AEB, AEC, ABC, BED, DEC, BCD, ABD and ACD are all possible triangles.

So, no. of triangles in one square = 8

So, by symmetry all 4 squares will have 8 triangles each

Thus, no. of triangles in all squares together considering one square at a time = 4*8 = 32

Now, consider all squares combined together

PQR, STU, RVW, ZST, QRV and TUY are all possible triangles

So, no. of triangles considering all squares combined together = 6

So, the total no. of triangles formed = 32 + 6 = 38
